we have developed a tool to automatically annotate data with relevant scientific information, which can be used by the user to understand the data.
the conversion of scientific papers into machine-readable files is a tedious job that requires human intervention and the resulting index is not always relevant.
the proposed method can be used to provide relevant scientific or technical content to Web interfaces, and that it is easy to apply to existing Web interfaces, without the need to modify them.

the following questions: 1) How to convert PDF papers into machined readable files? 2) How to index the content of those files? 3) How to use this index for the display of Web interfaces? 4) How to improve the quality of the index?

the integration of textual information into Web interfaces.

the approach has proven to be useful for the purpose of providing a user-friendly interface for data discovery.

the use of a full-text search index is a very convenient and powerful tool to provide a user with the most relevant information about the data that he is currently viewing.
it is possible to automatically annotate Web interfaces by using the content of scientific papers.
the use of a text corpus as an annotation source can be an efficient way to provide users with a large variety of relevant content.
